rows.note: Use this for the all-purpose physical folder that holds papers, rather than a computer folder.

example.english: This folder should go back in the cabinet.
example.traditional: 呢個文件夾要放返入個櫃。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 man6 gin2 gaap3 jiu3 fong3 faan1 jap6 go3 gwai6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a folder in a computer or other digital file system, rather than a paper folder.

example.english: I made a new folder on the computer.
example.traditional: 我喺電腦度整咗個新資料夾。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 din6 nou5 dou6 zing2 zo2 go3 san1 zi1 liu6 gaap3
